Hi Sara / Ben —

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for sending this over — we reviewed with the product and growth teams and attached a marked-up doc with edits (redlines_everwell_v2.docx). Two quick high-priority corrections/questions:

1) The brief lists "+42% reduction in mean time to resolution (MTTR)" — that should read "+24%" based on the pilot timeframe (Apr 1–May 31). Please update the chart and callout.

2) The usage screenshot shows 18k API calls in May; that number is correct, but please remove the per-token cost line in the public brief (we prefer not to publish unit cost).

Quote note: we like the sentiment but would prefer a shorter attribution. Suggested replace with: "Redwood helped us safely scale inference and cut response time in half during the pilot." (happy to tweak wording).

Attached: redlines_everwell_v2.docx with inline comments.

Will loop in PressWorks PR to coordinate timing once the draft is final.

Best,
Sara Thompson
Director, Growth Ops
Everwell Health
sara.thompson@everwell.io

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding Sara's redlines (attached). Two items I need you to confirm by EOD:

- Vivek: confirm the MTTR figure (Sara says it should be +24%) and whether the caveat about pilot window needs additional context. Can you also confirm the sanitized metric we can publish for the public brief?

- Marissa: remove the per-token cost line from the public-facing PDF and propose the shortened quote Sara suggested. Can you draft the final one-line quote options (2 variants) for Sara to pick between?

I'll keep Sara/Ben in the loop so they see our internal answers.

Thanks —
Kimberly

[Forwarded attachment: redlines_everwell_v2.docx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Everwell impact brief — draft for fact-check & quote sign-off

Kimberly / Marissa —

Confirmed with the analytics team: the +24% MTTR improvement is correct for the Apr 1–May 31 pilot window when compared to baseline. The +42% number looks like it came from an internal longer-window comparison (Apr 1–Jun 15) that mixed in a follow-up change. For the public brief we should use the conservative +24% and add a parenthetical: "pilot (Apr–May)".

Also, request to sanitize: keep the API calls number but remove any cost or per-token figures. We can add a qualitative note: "achieved significant per-request efficiency via KV caching and batching".

I'll attach a one-line technical blurb that you can drop into the final copy.

— Vivek
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Everwell impact brief — draft for fact-check & quote sign-off

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the quick review and helpful redlines. We've implemented the changes Kim/Vivek discussed:

- MTTR updated to "+24% (pilot Apr–May)" throughout.
- Removed per-token cost and associated table from the public brief.
- Replaced the longer quote with two optional one-line quotes (pick one):
  1) "Redwood helped us safely scale inference and cut response time in half during the pilot."
  2) "With Redwood, we scaled inference reliably and shortened response time by 24% in the pilot."

I've attached the revised PDF and a clean DOCX: everwell_impact_brief_draft_v2.docx. Also attaching the small technical blurb from Vivek for context.

Next steps: if you approve one of the quote options and the edits, we'll route the PDF to legal for signoff (should be quick) and coordinate with PressWorks for the announcement timeline.

Attachments: everwell_impact_brief_draft_v2.docx, vivek_tech_blurb.txt

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Kim —

This looks great, thank you. We approve the changes and prefer quote option 1 (the tighter version). A couple of small asks before final:

- Please update the callout on page 3 to read "Pilot period: Apr 1–May 31, 2026" (explicit year).
- In the acknowledgments, can you list Everwell's internal PM contact as "Jamal Rivera" (not the earlier placeholder)?

Once those tiny items are updated, we're happy to route to legal and press. Our PR team (PressWorks) will follow up with scheduling windows; they asked for the final PDF by Friday 7/9.

Thanks again — excited to move forward.

Warmly,
Sara Thompson
Director, Growth Ops
Everwell Health
